_about: TODO-34 (PLAN.Physics.AngularResolution, DR-5): MLEM iteration selection on seeds disjoint from every validation family. Hand-held head, Cs-137 662 keV window, 1 m source-detector (S = 1000 - D), non-cyclic, one-period grid (the fully coded field, +-3.64 deg). Pair on axis (+-0.5 element jitter per seed, axis x for even seeds, y for odd), 1 : 1, 1000 window counts per source, separations 0.75-3 elements, 50 pair + 50 single-source null acquisitions each, valleys 0.25 (claimed) and 0.5. Binary (engine pixel-centre matrix) and analytic pixel-area MLEM (8 x 8 samples per pixel, closed cells exp(-mu t)) recorded at many iteration counts; the frozen count minimises the resolved separation (>= 95 % pass, null <= 5 %, every larger separation also passing; ties to fewer iterations), angres/select_iterations.py.
